svg.title: What 5.9 kg lost in a 10-day fast was made of
svg.desc: What 5.9 kg lost in a 10-day fast was made of. Fat: 2.34 kg. Extracellular water: 1.6 kg. Glycogen + its water: 0.5 kg. Metabolically active tissue: 1.5 kg. Metabolically active tissue includes muscle, liver, kidneys, heart and intestine; the authors estimate it was 25% of weight lost.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What 5.9 kg lost in a 10-day fast was made of

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 16 healthy men, 10-day fast with about 200–250 kcal a day (Buchinger protocol). Estimates, kilograms.

svg.text: Lean soft tissue on the scale: about 60% of the loss. More than half of that

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: was water and glycogen; the tissue part was about 25% of the loss. At 3 months, weight and lean tissue

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: were still lower than before; fat mass was not (12 men followed up).

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Laurens C et al, J Cachexia Sarcopenia Muscle 2021 (PMID 34668663); lean change estimated from urinary nitrogen, water and glycogen.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Extracellular water includes stool loss from enemas. Not water-only; uncontrolled; co-funded by a company linked to the clinic.
